comment: A 401 from ARM whose body names the AAD expired-secret code. The usual path for an expired secret is a rejection at token acquisition, before a request is ever issued; this recording covers the belt-and-braces case where the expiry becomes visible in a response instead, which must still report AUTH_EXPIRED rather than SCOPE_UNVERIFIED (Req 12.13) because the fix is a rotation and not a role assignment.

headers.www-authenticate: Bearer authorization_uri="https://login.microsoftonline.com/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111", error="invalid_token", error_description="The access token is invalid"

error.message: AADSTS7000222: The provided client secret keys for app '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222' are expired. Visit the Azure portal to create new keys for your app: https://aka.ms/NewClientSecret.
